name: Kambove

queries.query: Kambove cadastral map parcel registry Democratic Republic of the Congo official
queries.result: Search found the official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs, its national circonscriptions page, the public land-record procedure catalogue, and a non-government BIC portal. No first-party Kambove map or parcel API was found.

queries.query: Kambove cadastre parcelles RDC service foncier officiel
queries.result: La recherche a trouvé le Ministère des Affaires Foncières, la liste nationale des circonscriptions, la procédure officielle de recherche foncière et un portail BIC non gouvernemental. Aucun visualiseur ou service vectoriel public de parcelles pour Kambove n'a été identifié.

registryEvidence.officialNationalCustodian: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la République démocratique du Congo
registryEvidence.assessment: The ministry's current national list identifies eight Haut-Katanga circonscriptions (including Likasi and Kipushi entries) but does not list Kambove. The ministry's research form is a submission workflow, not an open parcel map/API. No Kambove-specific local registry, cadastral map, or public parcel endpoint was evidenced.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP page retrieved; national cadastre administration and digitization material described, but no Kambove parcel layer or public geometry service exposed.
HTTP 200 HTML retrieved. Haut-Katanga is listed with eight circonscriptions; Kambove is not listed. This is custodian-directory evidence only, not evidence that parcels are absent.
Public form retrieved; it requests applicant identity and property-search details and is not a safe anonymous parcel geometry/API route. No form submitted.
Describes paid consultation through a Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre. General national procedure; no Kambove map, schema, CRS, native ID, or geometry.
Redirected to an authentication page. BIC landing page states service availability for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu, not Haut-Katanga/Kambove. No login or account creation attempted.
A historical Kambove geological/surface-terrain map-sheet catalogue record was found, but it is not a cadastral parcel registry and provides no safe native parcel IDs or parcel polygons.
